implementation: The centered Flutter member dialog is replaced with a web-like anchored profile popover. It loads authenticated member details, keeps retryable loading errors local to the popover, restores focus on close, handles Escape, and preserves the DM, same-voice volume and administrator voice-kick actions.

checks.name: Authenticated member profile contract
checks.observation: API test verifies GET /members/{user_id}, path encoding, session cookie and parsed profile fields.

checks.name: Anchored popover and retry behavior
checks.observation: Widget test verifies inline profile failure/retry, loaded identity, anchor alignment with the selected member row, viewport containment, Escape dismissal and focus return to the trigger row.

checks.name: Matched visual and physical-device acceptance
checks.reason: Requires matched web/Flutter screenshots and device keyboard/screen-reader review on macOS, Windows and Android.
